function.name: grep
function.description: Search UTF-8 file contents with a Python regular expression (re module). Prefer over bash grep/rg. Skips .git, node_modules, __pycache__, virtualenvs, cache directories, and binary files.

pattern.description: Python regex source, matched per line with re.search.

path.description: File or directory relative to the workspace. Default: workspace root.

glob.description: Optional filename/path filter (same matcher as the glob tool).

max_matches.description: Stop after this many matches. Default 50, hard cap 200.
